description_en: Deletes compliance packages from a specified account group. After a compliance package is deleted, the check results and check reports of the compliance package are also automatically deleted
description_zh: 删除指定账号组内的合规包。删除合规包后，该合规包的检查结果和检查报告也自动被删除
kebab_example: aliyun config delete-aggregate-compliance-packs --compliance-pack-ids cp-541e626622af00870000 --aggregator-id ca-04b3fd170e3400070000 --api-version 2020-09-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteAggregateCompliancePacks

parameters.help_en:
The compliance package IDs. Separate multiple compliance package IDs with commas (,).

For information about how to obtain a compliance package ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/262059.html
parameters.help_zh:
合规包ID。多个合规包ID之间用半角逗号（,）分隔。

关于如何获取合规包ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/262059.html
parameters.name: compliance_pack_ids

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。`ClientToken`只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The account group ID.

For information about how to obtain an account group ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255797.html
parameters.help_zh:
账号组ID。

关于如何获取账号组ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/255797.html
parameters.name: aggregator_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to delete the rules when the compliance package is deleted. Valid values:

true: Deletes the rules.

false (default): Does not delete the rules
parameters.help_zh:
删除合规包时是否同时删除规则。取值：

true：删除规则。

false（默认值）：不删除规则
parameters.name: delete_rule

OperateCompliancePacksResult.description_en: The result of the delete operation on the compliance packages
OperateCompliancePacksResult.description_zh: 删除合规包的操作结果

OperateCompliancePacks.description_en: The list of deleted compliance packages

items.description_en: The operation result of the compliance package

ErrorCode.description_en:
The error code.

If the compliance package is deleted, this parameter is empty.

If the compliance package fails to be deleted, this parameter displays the error code. For more information about error codes, see <props="china">Error Center (https://error-center.aliyun.com/status/product/Config)</props><props="intl">Error Center (https://error-center.alibabacloud.com/status/product/Config)</props>
ErrorCode.description_zh:
错误码。

当您删除合规包成功时，该参数为空。

当您删除合规包失败时，该参数显示错误码。错误码详情，请参见<props="china">错误中心 (https://error-center.aliyun.com/status/product/Config)</props><props="intl">错误中心 (https://error-center.alibabacloud.com/status/product/Config)</props>

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the operation is successful. Valid values:

true: The operation is successful.

false: The operation failed
Success.description_zh:
操作是否成功。取值：

true：成功。

false：失败
